[To [FMY](/person/1606) and CMY]My dear Friends,
Forgive us for not having remembered to write to you yesterday. Our dear [Sister](/person/796)[^1] departed like a babe from its mother’s arms with hardly a shudder, seemingly in the midst of a sweet sleep which had lasted a great many hours. God be thanked for her, and may He pour His rich blessings on you and all who love her.
It was at 9.30 yesterday morning; [my wife](/person/795) was poorly, but both she and [my brothers wife](/person/797) seem comfortably rested to-day.
In haste and love, yours always
[J. K.](/person/798)


[^1]: Keble’s eldest sister, Elizabeth Keble (1789/90-7 August 1860).
